messages:
Maria: Heads-up — preparing kernel ABI + quant bundle for tonight's quiet window. Planning to cut engine v3.4.2-quant. Need deploybot window + pin strategy. ETA 23:00 PST. @oncall please ack.
Tony: ack. Oncall here. What are rollback thresholds? CPU OOMs / perf regression?
Maria: Primary rollback triggers: >1% increase in p99 latency over baseline for 10m, >0.5% error rate increase, and any OOMs in matmul kernel. Also automatic pin if canary error rate spikes. We'll run 5% traffic canary for 20m then 25% then full.
Samira: FYI quant builds flaked in staging last run — kv-cache mismatch on A100-40. Patch pushed to packaging, but we should hold a sticky pin TTL 4h in case. See logs: ```packaging/quant-package: checksum mismatch on libmatmul.so```
Deploybot: deploybot: scheduled window 2025-02-10T23:00Z -> 2025-02-11T02:00Z. Command: /deploy engine:v3.4.2-quant --canary 5%:20m --wave 25%:20m --full --rollback-metrics latency,error,oom
Jay: :eyes: who's owning smoke run? I can do prebake + 5% canary smoke (loadgen + smoke-suite).
Maria: Thanks Jay. Plan: Jay run prebake on staging at 21:30 PST. Samira will sanity check packaging. Tony will monitor canary dashboards and be ready to pin. Anita will handle release notes snippet + changelog.
Anita: I'll assemble release notes. Need short blurb about kernel ABI change, quant improvements, and the fallback policy. Ping me any wording.
Samira: One more: add deployment tag 'thermal-safe' to nodes in region us-west-2 to avoid older drivers. Also set deploybot --pin-ttl=4h
Tony: Noted. If p99 regresses between 0.5-1% we throttle rollout (pause) and run perf probe. If >1% we rollback immediately.
Maria: Added to playbook. Also ensure tracing keys are enabled: trace=engine-canary-5201. If rollback happens, deploybot will auto-pin previous stable: engine:v3.4.1
Deploybot: deploybot: preflight checks passed 8/8. Locking the window. Reaction :thumbsup:
Jay: Prebake done 21:48 PST — all smoke green except a small kv-cache warning on instance a100-03. Samira investigating.
Samira: kv-cache warning is benign — fixed by packaging recompile. Re-run ok.
Tony: 5% canary started 23:05 PST. Dashboards look stable. p99 deviation +0.12%.
Maria: Proceeding to 25% in 25m unless we see spikes. Anita, draft RN note: 'engine v3.4.2-quant: kernel ABI bump for matmul v2, quant optimizations, thermal safety tags.' Keep it short.
Anita: Drafted and pushed to docs repo. PR #412. Linking.
Tony: 25% wave complete 23:40 PST. No errors. Proceeding to full rollout.
Deploybot: deploybot: full rollout began 23:50 PST. ETA finish 00:20 PST.
Tony: At 00:10 we saw p99 jump 1.5% for 3m across us-east-1. Rolling back.
Deploybot: deploybot: rollback initiated. Pin applied: engine:v3.4.1 pinned for 4h. Notifying SRE and product.
Maria: Thanks team. Postmortem: Samira, please collect packaging diff and matmul logs. Tony, gather canary charts. Anita, update release note to mark rollback and known issue. We'll reconvene at 0900 PST.
Samira: Logs uploaded to /shared/logs/5201112222/matmul.tar.gz. Packaging diff: added a missing rpath fix.
Anita: Release notes updated and PR amended with 'rollback due to p99 regression in us-east-1; root cause suspected packaging rpath; working on fix.'
Tony: I'll keep the pin overnight. If no further regressions, we can try a hotfix build tomorrow midday with an extended prebake.
